entities.name: Fernando Carlos Maletti
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Fernando Carlos Maletti was an Argentine prelate of the Catholic Church in Argentina. He served as bishop of San Carlos de Bariloche from 2001 until 2013 and as the bishop of Merlo-Moreno from 2013 until his death in 2022 at the age of 72.
